# Recompiled Xbox title: native build (generated by tools/android/pipeline.py)
#
# [android-port] One CMake project for every way the pipeline builds a title:
#   - Android (NDK toolchain file): libmain.so, which SDL's Java activity
#     loads; SDL2 is built from source beside it (XBR_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR).
#   - Linux / macOS: an executable, used by CI to run the very same generated
#     code and runtime on x86-64 and arm64 runners.
#   - XBR_COMPILE_CHECK=ON: every source compiled for the target, nothing
#     linked (tools/android/native.py --mode check, a cross-compiler with
#     bionic headers where no NDK can be installed). Proves compilation
#     only; it is never reported as a build.
#
# Inputs (set by the pipeline):
#   XBR_TOOLKIT_DIR      the xboxrecomp checkout
#   XBR_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR  pinned SDL2 source (Android, compile check)
#   XBR_GAME_NAME        executable name (desktop)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(xbr_game C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

set(XBR_TOOLKIT_DIR "" CACHE PATH "xboxrecomp checkout")
set(XBR_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "SDL2 source (Android)")
set(XBR_GAME_NAME "xbr_game" CACHE STRING "desktop executable name")
set(XBR_GEN_OPT "" CACHE STRING "extra compile options for the generated C only")
option(XBR_COMPILE_CHECK "compile every source for the target, link nothing" OFF)
# The NV2A render back end on Vulkan (src/vk), registered at boot unless
# RECOMP_VK=0. On for Android (and its compile check); a desktop build may
# turn it on too -- the loader is opened at run time, so a machine without
# Vulkan still runs, on the CPU rasteriser.
if(ANDROID OR XBR_COMPILE_CHECK)
    set(_xbr_vulkan_default ON)
else()
    set(_xbr_vulkan_default OFF)
endif()
option(XBR_VULKAN "build in the Vulkan render back end (src/vk)" ${_xbr_vulkan_default})
if(NOT XBR_TOOLKIT_DIR OR NOT EXISTS "${XBR_TOOLKIT_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "XBR_TOOLKIT_DIR must point at the xboxrecomp checkout")
endif()

# The bundled D3D8 layer is the Windows D3D11 path; this build presents through
# the pushbuffer executor (RECOMP_PB_EXEC) and the host presenter.
set(XBOXRECOMP_BUILD_D3D8 OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(XBOXRECOMP_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

if(XBR_COMPILE_CHECK)
    # Headers only: the check compiles against SDL's Android configuration
    # (SDL_config.h selects it from __ANDROID__) and builds no SDL.
    if(NOT XBR_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR OR NOT EXISTS "${XBR_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR}/include/SDL.h")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "XBR_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR must point at the pinned SDL2 source")
    endif()
    add_library(SDL2::SDL2 INTERFACE IMPORTED GLOBAL)
    set_target_properties(SDL2::SDL2 PROPERTIES
        INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${XBR_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
    set(SDL2_DIR "${XBR_TOOLKIT_DIR}/cmake/sdl2-subproject" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
elseif(ANDROID)
    if(NOT XBR_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR OR NOT EXISTS "${XBR_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "XBR_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR must point at the pinned SDL2 source")
    endif()
    set(SDL_SHARED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(SDL_STATIC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(SDL_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(${XBR_SDL2_SOURCE_DIR} ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/SDL2)
    # The toolkit asks find_package(SDL2) for SDL2::SDL2; answer it with the
    # target just built.
    set(SDL2_DIR "${XBR_TOOLKIT_DIR}/cmake/sdl2-subproject" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
endif()

add_subdirectory(${XBR_TOOLKIT_DIR} ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/xboxrecomp)
if(XBR_VULKAN)
    add_subdirectory(${XBR_TOOLKIT_DIR}/src/vk ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/xboxrecomp_vk)
    if(NOT TARGET xboxrecomp_vk)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "XBR_VULKAN=ON needs vulkan/vulkan.h: run "
                "`python3 -m tools.android.fetch_deps --only git` or set "
                "XBOXRECOMP_VULKAN_HEADERS_DIR (or configure with -DXBR_VULKAN=OFF)")
    endif()
endif()
add_subdirectory(${XBR_TOOLKIT_DIR}/src/host ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/xboxrecomp_host)

file(GLOB XBR_GEN_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen/*.c")
if(NOT XBR_GEN_SOURCES)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "no generated sources in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen")
endif()
file(GLOB XBR_GAME_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/game/*.c")

# Generated code: the lifter writes `if ((a == b))` at every compare, and the
# ABI is the guest's, not the host's, so these warnings are noise there.
set_source_files_properties(${XBR_GEN_SOURCES} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS
    "-w;-fno-strict-aliasing;-fwrapv")
if(XBR_GEN_OPT)
    separate_arguments(_xbr_gen_opt NATIVE_COMMAND "${XBR_GEN_OPT}")
    set_property(SOURCE ${XBR_GEN_SOURCES} APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_OPTIONS ${_xbr_gen_opt})
endif()

if(ANDROID)
    add_subdirectory(${XBR_TOOLKIT_DIR}/src/host/android ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/xboxrecomp_android)
endif()

if(XBR_COMPILE_CHECK)
    add_library(xbr_game_check STATIC ${XBR_GEN_SOURCES} ${XBR_GAME_SOURCES})
    target_include_directories(xbr_game_check PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen)
    target_link_libraries(xbr_game_check PRIVATE xboxrecomp_host)
elseif(ANDROID)
    # SDL's Java side loads "main".
    add_library(main SHARED ${XBR_GEN_SOURCES} ${XBR_GAME_SOURCES})
    target_include_directories(main PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen)
    target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE xboxrecomp_android xboxrecomp_host xboxrecomp)
    # Keep the dynamic symbol table: the crash handler names guest functions
    # (sub_XXXXXXXX) with dladdr, and SDL finds SDL_main through it. 16 KB
    # segment alignment loads on 4 KB- and 16 KB-page devices alike.
    target_link_options(main PRIVATE -Wl,--export-dynamic -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384)
else()
    add_executable(${XBR_GAME_NAME} ${XBR_GEN_SOURCES} ${XBR_GAME_SOURCES}
                   ${XBR_TOOLKIT_DIR}/src/host/xbr_main_posix.c)
    target_include_directories(${XBR_GAME_NAME} PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen)
    target_link_libraries(${XBR_GAME_NAME} PRIVATE xboxrecomp_host xboxrecomp)
    if(NOT APPLE)
        target_link_options(${XBR_GAME_NAME} PRIVATE -rdynamic)
    endif()
endif()
